metadata.title: Lania Network - Minecraft Servers
metadata.description: Private server for comfortable game in vanilla Minecraft.

landing.description: The best place for your expression in Minecraft.

section2.title: Community
section2.description1: We host players who enjoy all possible gaming styles.
section2.description2: Whether it's architecture, lorax exploration, events, farm construction or even computer design in Minecraft - any of your interests can be implemented on the Lania servers.

section3.title: Why Lania?
section3.description: In the world there are so many private Minecraft servers, why choose us?

vanilla.title: Clean vanilla
vanilla.description: Our server runs on the original version of Minecraft without modifications. However, we have <features>some quality-of-life features</features> that will help you in survival and creativity.
vanilla.description2: The version of the game required to enter the server can be found <requirements>here</requirements>.

noLicense.title: No license required
noLicense.description: We strive to make the server as accessible as possible to all players, without requiring a license to enter the server.
noLicense.description2: * However, the administration does not approve of piracy. Therefore, as good Samaritans Mojang, we recommend that you purchase a Minecraft license as soon as possible, in order to not break the laws and not expose yourself to risk.

staff.title: Our staff
staff.description: Our staff is professionals with a huge amount of experience, who are always ready to help you. We have been creating Minecraft servers for more than 10 years.
staff.description2: The list of our administrators can be found <staff>here</staff>.

optimization.title: Quality and optimization
optimization.description: We strive to make the server as high-quality and optimized as possible, so that you can comfortably immerse yourself in the game world.
optimization.description2: We have our own backend, plugins, powerful servers and much more.

noPayToWin.title: No pay-to-win
noPayToWin.description: We do not modify the game in any way, violating the balance of the game, including <hover>visual balance</hover>, so that players do not feel dissonance and can comfortably immerse themselves in the game world.
noPayToWin.balanceHover: Visual balance in games is a harmonious combination of all visual elements, creating a pleasant and whole perception of the game. It is not just a beautiful art, but a consistency between characters, environment, interface and other elements, so that the player does not feel dissonance and can comfortably immerse themselves in the game world.

promotionOfCreativity.title: Promotion of creativity and self-expression
promotionOfCreativity.description: We encourage creativity and provide players with the opportunity to express themselves and receive recognition in our community.

partnershipProgram.title: Partnership program
partnershipProgram.element1: If you are part of the audience of any content creator, then this is an opportunity for you to play together with him in Minecraft.
partnershipProgram.element2: If you are a content creator, you can start earning on selling passes, as well as have additional benefits.
partnershipProgram.seeMore: Learn more about the partnership program.

section4.title: Get access now!
section4.description: Get access to the Lania servers and start your adventure.

survival.title: Survival
survival.description: World with all the possible conveniences for construction and self-expression. Here the most beautiful buildings are created by players of the entire network of servers.

farms.title: Farms
farms.description: Farms world is intended for the construction of personal and common farms, but living here is not prohibited.

users.title: Users
users.searchLimit: Showing {count}. Search looks for part of an email among the first 10,000 accounts.

owner.title: Owner
owner.description: The profile belongs to the user with this email. The limit of profiles per user is not checked.
owner.releaseConfirmDescription: The profile will have no owner, and any user will be able to claim it. Its accesses and cosmetics stay with the profile.

grants.title: Granted
grants.description: Accesses and cosmetics of the profile. Revoked items stay as history.
grants.revokeConfirmDescription: For access to the primary season the player is removed from the whitelist when no other access remains. A selected color or prefix that is no longer available is reset.
grants.syncConfirmDescription: The revoke is already saved. This repeats the update of the whitelist or prefix on the game server.

grantDialog.title: Grant a product
grantDialog.description: The product is granted without payment. It is refused when the profile already has it for the season.

cosmeticDialog.title: Grant a name color or prefix
cosmeticDialog.description: Any color or prefix can be granted, also ones that are not for sale. The player picks it in the profile settings as usual, the game is not changed. It is refused when the profile already has the item.
cosmeticDialog.prefixTypeHint: A player wears one glyth and one special prefix at a time.
